name: Seo Skills
description: Production-ready SEO toolkit for Claude — 25 specialist skills that turn raw search data into finished deliverables. Covers content briefs, technical and E-E-A-T content audits, keyword clusters, competitor and backlink gap analysis, AI Search share of voice across ChatGPT / Perplexity / Gemini / AI Overview, page-level intelligence, structured data, sitemap and hreflang validation, local SEO, and Google's own APIs (GSC, PSI, CrUX, GA4, Indexing). Powered by the SE Ranking MCP server.
longDescription:
Ships **32 skills** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (32): `ai-search-gaps-to-social-campaign` (Find the AI-search prompts and topics where a brand is invisible (or losing to competitors) in SE Ranking,…), `client-onboarding-proposal` (Build a data-backed client onboarding proposal for an agency starting a new engagement, combining an SE Ranking SEO…), `local-gmb-visibility` (Build and track local search visibility with SE Ranking city-level rank tracking and turn it into local social…), `seo-ads` (Paid-search competitive landscape for a domain or keyword), `seo-agency-landing-page` (Generate a demand-gen landing page for an SEO agency, complete with pain-point hook, proof, a free-audit lead magnet…), `seo-ai-search-share-of-voice` (Measure AI Search share of voice for a target domain versus competitors across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI…), `seo-ai-social-report` (Generate one unified performance report that brings together SEO rankings, AI-search visibility (SE Ranking) and social engagement (Planable)…), `seo-api` (SE Ranking API integration architect), and 24 more
- **MCP servers** (1): `se-ranking`

Installs with `claude plugin install seo-skills@claude-community` from `seranking/seo-skills`.
